Electron resolves resources RELATIVE TO THE EXE, so this is portable-safe. Linux and macOS keep the current layout entirely (.sh/.command are not SAC-blocked) - this is a win32 branch inside build-portable.mjs, not a global change.

ALREADY PROVEN SAFE, do not re-investigate: resolveMainPortableRoot() (main.js:527-537) and resolveMainResourcesPath() (main.js:539-549) both work UNCHANGED - app.isPackaged flips true and process.resourcesPath becomes real. And `resources/` does NOT collide: MPI owns resources/cubric, resources/icons, resources/ffmpeg.exe; Electron owns resources/app/ + default_app.asar.

key_decisions: NO code-signing certificate and NO NSIS installer. User decision, 2026-07-29. Signing does not fix SAC (it starts the reputation clock, it does not skip it; EV no longer grants instant reputation and OV is now equivalent; SAC blocks signed binaries with unknown reputation). An installer would replace the whole portable update system for a benefit signing has to pay for anyway. The relayout is a SUBSET of installer work, so nothing done here is wasted if an installer is ever adopted.

An unsigned root CubricVision.exe is the accepted outcome. It will not necessarily clear SAC on a fresh Windows 11 box, but it converts a hard block with no override into standard SmartScreen with a 'More info -> Run anyway' path for everyone not on SAC.
Windows-only branch. Linux .sh and macOS .command are not SAC-blocked and their layout stays exactly as-is.
MPI-387 is an UMBRELLA card and D is a sub-item - do NOT close the card when D lands. F1/F2/F3 remain.
Release base is still PARKED. master is 116+ commits / 167 non-doc files ahead of v1.2.0, so it is not a patch. No branch has been created - do not create one without the user naming the base.

nimbalyst (github.com/nimbalyst/nimbalyst) is the user's reference for a Windows app that installs cleanly. It uses electron-builder + NSIS + publisherName + mac notarization - i.e. they paid for signing. Useful as a layout reference, NOT a licence to adopt their toolchain.
constraints: THE .lnk ROUTE IS DEAD. Verified empirically: a shortcut stores an ABSOLUTE target path, so it cannot survive a portable zip extracted to an arbitrary folder. Do not re-propose it.
THE EXTRACTION-RACE THEORY IS DEAD. The captured log proves node extraction does not race engine extraction and all 14 extractions succeeded. Do not re-open it.
THE UPDATE ARCHIVE NAME IS FROZEN (MPI-369) - shipped updaters glob CubricVision-<platform>-<arch>-update-v*.zip by name. Only the extracted root folder name is free.

THE WINDOWS FULL ZIP MUST STAY ROOTLESS (MPI-387 fix A, build-portable.mjs:1062 includeRoot: opts.platform !== 'win32'). Re-adding an inner root re-breaks a default Downloads extract by 32 characters. Linux .tar.gz always carries a root; macOS uses ditto --keepParent. Do not 'tidy' this back.
THE ENGINE ROOT BUDGET IS 89 CHARS on Windows (260 MAX_PATH minus the measured 171-char deepest engine-relative file). The relayout must not lengthen the path from the zip root to the engine.
No symptom patches. If the relayout breaks the updater, fix the updater - do not add a compatibility shim that leaves both layouts alive.
The CHANGELOG hold on masking still stands: one UNRELEASED.md entry when MPI-368 shapes land, not per-card. This does not block changelog entries for install fixes - two were added this session.
Docs-repo push block still applies. git push is user-authorized only.
